text.title: Content Refresh SOP Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the content refresh playbook step: the numeric thresholds for the three signals written before scoring, the trailing and prior windows with their data source, and one row per evergreen URL at least 12 months old carrying the GSC, GA4 and rank-tracker dataset for both windows, the computed signals, exactly one verdict from refresh / consolidate / kill / leave, and the verdict's own block: the nine-step checklist with exit criteria, unchanged URL, 28-day baseline and day-90 re-evaluation for a refresh; survivor, redirect map and link rewrite for a consolidate; 410 with sitemap and navigation removal and no redirect for a kill; reason and next review date for a leave. Validator at scripts/validate-content-refresh-sop.py enforces it, including the signal arithmetic and the 90-day date.

required.field: `impressions_trend_pct` (negative), `position_decay_positions` (positive), `intent_shift_query_mix_pct` (positive), fixed before any URL is scored (r-three-signals-with-thresholds)
`trailing_days`, `prior_days` equal to it, `span_months`, `source` persisted_export or search_console_ui; spans over 16 months must read from a persisted export (r-one-dataset-gsc-ga4-rank)

one row per URL: `evergreen: true`, `url_age_months` at least 12, `dataset` with `gsc` (clicks, impressions, avg_position), `ga4` (sessions, key_events) and `rank` (target_query, position) for `trailing` and `prior`, `signals` computed from the dataset, one `verdict`, and the verdict's block (r-eligibility-evergreen-12-months, r-one-dataset-gsc-ga4-rank, r-four-verdicts-exhaustive)

`url_unchanged: true`, `substantive_change: true`, `date_modified_updated`, `title_changed_for_intent`, `checklist[]` of the nine steps each with `exit_criterion` and `done` (a skipped step carries `skipped_reason`), `baseline` (published_at, 28-day clicks, impressions, avg_position, sessions, key_events), `reevaluation_at` = published_at + 90 days (r-refresh-keeps-url-honest-date, r-nine-step-checklist-complete, r-baseline-and-90-day-reevaluation)

`survivor_url`, `merged_urls[]`, `redirects[]` with `from`, `to` = survivor, `status` 301 or 308, `internal_links_rewritten: true`, plus `baseline` and `reevaluation_at` (r-consolidate-301-to-survivor, r-baseline-and-90-day-reevaluation)
one branch per signal naming the threshold it applies and the verdict it routes to (r-three-signals-with-thresholds)

forbidden.pattern: a refresh with `date_modified_updated: true` and `substantive_change: false`, or a checklist without steps 2, 4 and 6 done — date-bump-without-change
a row whose `dataset` lacks `gsc`, `ga4` or `rank` for either window, or `signals` that do not recompute from the dataset — single-source-verdict
a consolidate with a merged URL that has no redirect to the survivor, or `internal_links_rewritten: false` — consolidation-without-redirects
a kill with a `redirect_target`, or `http_status` other than 410 / 404 — kill-redirected-to-homepage
a refresh or consolidate without `baseline` or with `reevaluation_at` not 90 days after `baseline.published_at` — no-post-refresh-baseline
a URL with `evergreen: false` or `url_age_months` under 12, or a verdict outside refresh / consolidate / kill / leave — r-eligibility-evergreen-12-months, r-four-verdicts-exhaustive
`window.span_months` above 16 with `source: search_console_ui`, or `prior_days` different from `trailing_days` — r-one-dataset-gsc-ga4-rank

list.item: Every scored URL is `evergreen: true` with `url_age_months` at least 12 (r-eligibility-evergreen-12-months).
Every row carries GSC, GA4 and rank-tracker figures for both windows of equal length; a span over 16 months reads from a persisted export (r-one-dataset-gsc-ga4-rank).
`thresholds` and `decision_branches` name numbers for impressions trend, position decay and intent shift; `signals` recompute from the dataset (r-three-signals-with-thresholds).
Exactly one verdict per URL from the four; a leave has a reason and a next review date (r-four-verdicts-exhaustive).
A consolidate redirects every merged URL to the survivor with 301 or 308 and rewrites internal links (r-consolidate-301-to-survivor).
A kill returns 410 or 404, leaves the sitemap and navigation, drops internal links, and redirects nowhere (r-kill-returns-410-never-homepage).
A refresh keeps the URL and updates `dateModified` only with a substantive change (r-refresh-keeps-url-honest-date).
A refresh lists all nine checklist steps with exit criteria; a skipped step carries its reason (r-nine-step-checklist-complete).
Every refresh and consolidate records a 28-day baseline on publication and a `reevaluation_at` 90 days later (r-baseline-and-90-day-reevaluation).

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the signal and date arithmetic.
